test_interpolate_no_op: test DataFrame.interpolate with pad, nearest, and linear methods for no-op copy-on-write behavior
test_interp_fill_functions: test DataFrame.ffill and DataFrame.bfill trigger the same copy-on-write code paths as interpolate
test_interpolate_triggers_copy: test that ffill and bfill trigger a copy when NaN values are present in numeric or datetime columns
test_interpolate_inplace_no_reference_no: test DataFrame.interpolate inplace does not copy when no references exist
test_interpolate_inplace_with_refs: test DataFrame.interpolate inplace triggers a copy when views reference the original data
test_interp_fill_functions_inplace: test DataFrame.ffill and DataFrame.bfill inplace trigger copies with float64 and Float64 dtypes
test_interpolate_cannot_with_object_dtyp: test that DataFrame.interpolate raises TypeError for object dtype columns
test_interpolate_object_convert_no_op: test that interpolate on object dtype does not trigger an unnecessary copy-on-write copy
test_interpolate_object_convert_copies: test that interpolate with pad method on numeric data raises ValueError and does not copy
test_interpolate_downcast_reference_trig: test that interpolate with pad method on data with references raises ValueError and triggers a copy
test_fillna: test DataFrame.fillna with scalar value shares memory for unaffected columns under copy-on-write
test_fillna_dict: test DataFrame.fillna with dict argument copies only affected columns and shares others
test_fillna_inplace: test DataFrame.fillna inplace without references preserves memory sharing
test_fillna_inplace_reference: test DataFrame.fillna inplace triggers a copy on affected columns when views exist
test_fillna_interval_inplace_reference: test Series.fillna inplace on interval dtype triggers a copy when views exist
test_fillna_series_empty_arg: test Series.fillna with empty dict shares memory under copy-on-write
test_fillna_series_empty_arg_inplace: test Series.fillna with empty dict inplace preserves memory sharing
test_fillna_ea_noop_shares_memory: test DataFrame.fillna on extension array dtypes triggers a copy for affected columns
test_fillna_inplace_ea_noop_shares_memor: test DataFrame.fillna inplace on extension array dtypes triggers a copy when views exist
test_fillna_chained_assignment: test that DataFrame.fillna inplace on chained assignment raises an error
test_interpolate_chained_assignment: test that interpolate, ffill, and bfill inplace on chained assignment raise errors
